text_block_list.name: Both as Children
text_block_list.text:
Pinky promise, cross my heart!
From now on, together...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—"Let's keep running together, forever and
wherever."
That was a promise made in our childhood.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Number one rivals and best friends."
I truly believed without a single doubt
that we would stay like that forever.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
She was purely innocent...
And yetâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Display event title logo.

text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: —ack-san. Kitasan Black-san!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —Ha! I-I-I wasn't sleeping!!

text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"...Winter break is just around the
corner, but do not let your guard down.
Now then, for those students heading home,
do not forget to submit your leave forms
to the dorms—"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Haaah, I blew it...!
Just because I'm busy is no excuse to
space out...!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Interviews are packed after school, and I
want to do independent training too...
Ah... That's right, if I recall, today
Dia-chan is also...!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Dia-chan, you have a meeting for
merchandise outside later too, right?
Wanna walk to the station together?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Kita-chan!
I think I'm going to be late today, so I
really have to rush!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: See you again tonight~~~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"......Ugh, Dia-chan's schedule is totally
packed too~!
Even at lunch she had a phone interview,
so we couldn't eat together..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Is the only time we have to talk when
we're back at the dorm...?
No, lately it feels like we both just come
back to sleep..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I could never have imagined my days being
this fulfilling before enrolling.
...Alright, I'm gonna give it my all too!!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
—All right, that's a wrap! Great work,
everyone!!
Man, things were hectic, but it turned out
to be a great way to close out the year.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Alright, next is the Monthly Twinkle
interview! Change and head over...!
And after that, the meeting with the
horseshoe maker about custom shoes...!)

text_block_list.name: Event Planner
text_block_list.text:
—Very well, we will proceed with Plan C
for the new merchandise design.
We'll also have Satono Diamond confirm the
fabric samples before the end of the
year...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's make our decision today.
Let's see, the one with the color closest
to the racing silks is—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder if Kita-chan is doing her best
right now, too...?
Whoops, focus, focus...!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (The relentless year-end rush...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (If I can just push through this...!)

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
(Finally, my day off matches Dia-chan's!!)
(Finally, my day off matches
Kita-chan's!!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Haaaah, it's sooo good...! It's warming me
up from the inside.
When was the last time I could take it
easy and just enjoy a meal...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Seriously. It was just non-stop hustle and
bustle!
And there were major races at the end of
the year, too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Things will get super busy again right
after New Year's, so I won't have time to
go home, but...
at least let's chill out together for the
end of the year♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's do it, let's do it!
I've got so many things I've been dying to
talk about~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
――Ahaha, really? Sounds like you had your
hands full~!
Oh, by the way, what happened with that
magazine modeling gig you mentioned
before?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a model for an elementary school
fashion magazine!
Sweep-san actually got an offer for that
too, so we did the photoshoot together.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh?! Really?! News to me...!
I mean, that's amazing. I had no idea you
went that far~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Dia-chan is really a full-fledged star
Umamusume now...!
Even though she used to be a bit of a
spoiled sweetie back then...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"(...Somehow, I think I'm getting fired
up!
After all, I'm her best friend and her
rival...!")"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hm-hm-hmmm♪ The town's so empty and easy
to walk around during the homecoming
season.
Wait, oh...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan, look, look! I found an
interesting back alley♪
Alright, let's check it out!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! A back alley...?
Jeez, you always run off ahead! Wait, wait
up~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh? Is the path getting narrower and
narrower...?
Are we gonna be okay? It's kind of getting
dark, too...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wh-Where is this place...?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a shrine...? It has quite a charming
atmosphere...
To think such a fascinating spot was right
in our neighborhood...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Eep... Isn't that a little dangerous?
Besides, it looks like something might
'appear' there...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Wait, 'appear'...? Oh?
Look, Kita-chan. Did that pile of fallen
leaves over there just move...?
――Come... Come to meeee...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek!!? I-It's heeereeeee!?
Dia-chan, runnnn!!" || "Eeeek!!? I-It's
heeereeeee!?
Dia-chan, ruuuuun!!
